title: 牛津3000核心词 (Oxford 3000)
description: 牛津官方认证的英语最核心、最高频且最实用的3000词汇精选

words.translation: vt. 达到，实现；完成，取得
words.example: She worked tirelessly to achieve her childhood ambition.
words.exampleTrans: 她不知疲倦地工作以实现儿时的抱负。

words.translation: vt. 承认；致谢；告知收到
words.example: He refused to acknowledge his mistake in public.
words.exampleTrans: 他拒绝在公开场合承认自己的错误。

words.translation: vt. 获得，习得；学到；收购
words.example: Children acquire their native language naturally from exposure.
words.exampleTrans: 孩子们通过日常接触自然地习得母语。

words.translation: v. 使适应，适合；改编
words.example: Successful species adapt quickly to changing environments.
words.exampleTrans: 成功的物种能够迅速适应不断变化的环境。

words.translation: adj. 足够的，充实的；合格胜任的
words.example: The team did not have adequate resources to finish on time.
words.exampleTrans: 该团队没有足够的资源按时完成任务。

words.translation: vt. 提倡，主张；n. 拥护者，倡导者
words.example: Doctors advocate regular physical exercise for heart health.
words.exampleTrans: 医生主张进行规律的体育锻炼以保持心脏健康。

words.translation: v. 改变，修改，调整
words.example: Little things can alter the entire course of a life.
words.exampleTrans: 微小的事情也能彻底改变人生的轨迹。

words.translation: adj. 显而易见的，明白的；表面的
words.example: It soon became apparent that the plan would not succeed.
words.exampleTrans: 很快显而易见的是，该计划不会成功。

words.translation: v. 接近，走近；着手处理；n. 方法，途径
words.example: We decided to adopt a more creative approach to the problem.
words.exampleTrans: 我们决定对该问题采取一种更具创造性的方法。

words.translation: adj. 适当的，得体的，合适的
words.example: Please ensure you wear appropriate attire for the formal meeting.
words.exampleTrans: 请确保穿着适合正式会议的得体服装。

words.translation: n. 方面；面貌；朝向
words.example: We examined every aspect of the proposal before voting.
words.exampleTrans: 在投票之前，我们审查了该提案的每一个方面。

words.translation: vt. 评估，评定；估价，征税
words.example: The teacher will assess students based on their coursework.
words.exampleTrans: 老师将根据学生的平时作业来评估他们。

words.translation: vt. 假设，假定；承担；呈现
words.example: It is dangerous to assume anything without concrete evidence.
words.exampleTrans: 在没有确凿证据的情况下做任何假设都是危险的。

words.translation: n. 权威，威信；官方，当局；专家
words.example: The health authority issued a severe warning to residents.
words.exampleTrans: 卫生当局向居民发出了严重警告。

words.translation: adj. 可获得的，可利用的；有空的
words.example: The new feature is available to all registered users today.
words.exampleTrans: 新功能今天已对所有注册用户开放使用。

words.translation: n. 利益，好处；v. 有益于；获益
words.example: Both companies will benefit from this strategic partnership.
words.exampleTrans: 两家公司都将从这次战略合作中获益。

words.translation: adj. 有能力的，能干的；有潜力的
words.example: She is fully capable of handling intense pressure.
words.exampleTrans: 她完全有能力应对巨大的压力。

words.translation: n. 容量；能力，才能；身份
words.example: The stadium was filled to capacity with excited fans.
words.exampleTrans: 体育场里挤满了激动的球迷，座无虚席。

words.translation: n. 条件，环境；状况，境遇
words.example: Under no circumstances should you open suspicious email attachments.
words.exampleTrans: 在任何情况下你都不应该打开可疑的邮件附件。

words.translation: vt. 阐明，澄清；使纯净
words.example: Could you clarify what you mean by that statement?
words.exampleTrans: 你能澄清一下你说那句话的意思吗？

words.translation: v. 承诺；致力于；犯(错/罪)；投入
words.example: They committed all their savings to starting the new venture.
words.exampleTrans: 他们投入了全部积蓄来开展这项新的创业。

words.translation: vt. 实施，进行；指挥；传导；n. 行为
words.example: Scientists conduct experiments to test their hypotheses.
words.exampleTrans: 科学家们进行实验来检验他们的假设。

words.translation: vt. 证实，确认；批准，使坚信
words.example: The lab tests confirmed that the water was completely safe.
words.exampleTrans: 化验结果证实该水源完全安全。

words.translation: n. 结果，后果；重要性
words.example: He must face the consequences of his own careless actions.
words.exampleTrans: 他必须为自己粗心大意的行为承担后果。

words.translation: adj. 关键的，至关重要的；决定性的
words.example: Sleep plays a crucial role in cognitive health and memory.
words.exampleTrans: 睡眠对认知健康和记忆力起着至关重要的作用。

words.translation: n./v. 辩论，争论；讨论
words.example: The proposal sparked intense debate among legislators.
words.exampleTrans: 该提案在立法者中引发了激烈的辩论。

words.translation: vt. 演示，示范；论证，证明；游行
words.example: The chef demonstrated how to prepare the classic sauce.
words.exampleTrans: 大厨亲自示范了如何调制这款经典酱汁。

words.translation: adj. 截然不同的；清晰的，明显的
words.example: There are three distinct stages in this training program.
words.exampleTrans: 在这个培训项目中，有三个截然不同的阶段。

words.translation: n. 多样性，多样化；差异
words.example: Biodiversity is essential for sustaining healthy ecosystems.
words.exampleTrans: 生物多样性对于维持健康的生态系统至关重要。

words.translation: vt. 强调，着重；使突出
words.example: The coach emphasized the importance of teamwork and discipline.
words.exampleTrans: 教练着重强调了团队合作与纪律的重要性。
